ns2:course.label: Intro to Human Nutrition
ns2:course.description: Introductory course for students in Human Nutrition. Explore department, college and campus resources. Learn about current issues, opportunities, and careers in the nutrition field. Prerequisite: FSHN major with a concentration in Human Nutrition only.
ns2:course.courseSectionInformation: Prerequisite: FSHN major with a concentration in Human Nutrition only.
